hosts.tooltip: Leave empty to use every host from glab that has a token. Tokens come from 'glab auth login'.

activity-days.description: Only projects with activity within the last

only-mine.tooltip: Show only pipelines started by your own pushes, merge requests, manual runs or schedules you own.

username.tooltip: Empty = the user logged in via glab on each host. Either one name for all hosts (alice) or per host: gitlab.example.com=alice, git.company.com=bob

show-count.description: Show number of running pipelines next to the icon

animate.description: Blink icon while pipelines are running

notify.description: Desktop notification when a pipeline finishes
